openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing blue and argue it is the safe/cooperative choice, but they incorrectly claim blue is dominant/safe and that pressing red can lead to your death when blue wins (they also misstate the dominance structure).

gemini.reasoning: The respondent consistently chooses blue based on a cooperative/collective survival framework. They demonstrate a fundamental rule error by repeatedly claiming that red-pressers die if the majority is blue (the rules state everyone survives if the majority is blue) and by claiming that red-pressers die if the majority is red (the rules state red-pressers survive if the majority is red).
